Enough to power on and reach the box, which is the question most people ask first and the one `default` used to answer with whatever the drawing happened to be populated with. The line-card slots are drawn EMPTY rather than blanked, which is not the intent: no MX10000-series line-card blank is modelled, and none is named in the staged guides - they document power-supply cover panels only. Every other chassis in the library seats a blank here.","kind":"base","source":"vendor - Juniper publishes this as an orderable bundle. the hardware guide's 'MX10016 Components and Configurations' section lists the components of each configuration, and the line-card covers in this base are its own: it ships sixteen of them on the MX10016 in EVERY configuration, over the note that \"Line cards and the cable management system are not part of the base or redundant configurations. You must order them separately.\" NOT YET FULLY FAITHFUL: the vendor bundle also ships ONE routing engine rather than two, and covers rather than modules in one SFB slot and one power slot. This library seats all of them, because JNP10K-PWR-BLNK and the SF blank are not modelled yet.
